code:
bison -d calc.y
flex calc.l
gcc calc.tab.c lex.yy.c calc.c -o calc
echo '3 + 5 * (2 - 8)' | ./calc
description: These commands generate the parser and lexer, compile the program, and provide one expression.

steps.description: Bison generates parser files, Flex generates lexer code, and GCC compiles all three C sources.
The final command pipes an arithmetic expression into calc.

title: Generate and run the calculator
